notes.title: INJECTION - Major Demo Update for Debut Festival 2025
notes.content: [p]We’re thrilled to announce that [b]INJECTION[/b] has been selected for [b]Debut Festival 2025[/b]![/p][p]To celebrate, we're releasing a [b]major update[/b] to the demo - featuring new content, gameplay refinements and improved visuals, This marks the biggest update to the demo since its original launch.[/p][p]Whether you're returning to dive deeper into the chaos or trying the game for the first time, now is the perfect moment.[/p][p]Stay brutal.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🩸 [b]Changelog - Debut Festival Update[/b][/h3][p][b]50+ fixes, tweaks, and additions.[/b][/p][p]🎯 Combat & Enemies[/p][list][*][p]Added weapon recoil animations[/p][/*][*][p]Improved Nailgun firing animation[/p][/*][*][p]Enemies won’t cluster in one spot anymore (unless forced)[/p][/*][*][p]Enemies react to grenades, flashbangs, and explosions[/p][/*][*][p]Enemies won’t attack immediately after spawning[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed enemy AI reacting to empty space[/p][/*][*][p]New “Quick Finish” action: kill right after detection[/p][/*][*][p]Enemies ignore sounds and kills while stunned[/p][/*][*][p]Stun now resets properly[/p][/*][*][p]Stunned enemies become aggressive after recovery[/p][/*][/list][p]💥 Visuals & Effects[/p][list][*][p]Particle systems now have lifespans (performance boost)[/p][/*][*][p]Added particles and debris when breaching doors[/p][/*][*][p]Door debris stays after explosion[/p][/*][*][p]Improved blood splatter on walls[/p][/*][*][p]New adrenaline injection effect[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked hit effects (including turrets)[/p][/*][*][p]Improved dash visuals[/p][/*][*][p]Smooth slow-motion at level end[/p][/*][*][p]Visual fixes and brightness adjustments[/p][/*][/list][p]🧠 UI / UX / Game Feel[/p][list][*][p]Better UI/UX polish throughout[/p][/*][*][p]Improved aim assist[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked intro sequence (less text, more impact)[/p][/*][*][p]Updated disclaimer screen[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes for overlapping/misaligned text[/p][/*][*][p]Level end screen scoring fixed[/p][/*][*][p]Better gamepad tutorial[/p][/*][*][p]Tutorial level can now be replayed[/p][/*][/list][p]📜 Actions & Stats[/p][list][*][p]New “Untouched” action: finish level without taking damage[/p][/*][*][p]New action tracking screen: see all level achievements[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed incorrect action/stat tracking[/p][/*][*][p]Improved accuracy stats calculation[/p][/*][/list][p]🚪 World Logic[/p][list][*][p]Doors can now be opened from both sides with correct animations[/p][/*][*][p]Improved explosion reactions[/p][/*][*][p]Smoothed pathfinding logic[/p][/*][/list][p]🛠 Editor / Tech[/p][list][*][p]Improved level editor stability[/p][/*][*][p]Steam Cloud support fix[/p][/*][*][p]Workshop support (full version only)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Misc. softlock and bug fixes[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]🩸And more...[/p]

notes.title: 💉 INJECTION - New Demo Update
notes.content:
[h2]We’ve released an update for the INJECTION demo!
Now it:[/h2]
[h2][list]
[*] It looks better: improved effects, graphics, and atmosphere
[*] It runs smoother: improved performance on all machines
[*] More pain: even more blood, gore, and dismemberment added
[*] Fewer problems: numerous bugs fixed, enemy behavior improved
[/list][/h2]

[h2]It’s still an early version, but closer to our final vision.
Check out the new demo, leave feedback, and if you liked it, add it to your wishlist![/h2]

[h2]🔗[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2134690/INJECTION/]INJECTION[/url][/h2]

notes.title: Ongoing Optimization, QoL Improvements & New Localizations
notes.content:
Hello, mercenaries!

We're excited to share that we’re actively working on optimizing Injection to ensure a smoother and more stable experience. Our team is focused on performance improvements, bug fixes, and overall quality-of-life changes to enhance gameplay.

[h2]What’s in the works?[/h2]
🔹 Optimization & Performance Boosts – Improving frame rates and reducing load times.
🔹 Quality of Life Enhancements – Tweaks based on player feedback for a better experience.
🔹 New Localizations – Expanding language support to bring Injection to more players around the world.
🔹 Gameplay Adjustments – Balancing mechanics and refining combat for a smoother flow.

We appreciate your support and feedback as we continue improving the game. Stay tuned for more updates, and keep tearing through the chaos!

notes.title: Unleashing the Power of Music - Joining Forces with Acryll Madness!
notes.content:
[h3]Dear gamers and adrenaline seekers,

[b]Exciting news![/b] ButterCorp is teaming up with the brilliant music maker [b][url=https://soundcloud.com/acrylmadness]Acryll Madness[/url][/b] to create a gaming experience like no other in our upcoming platformer, "Injection". [/h3]

[b]Feel the rush[/b] as you dive into a twisted hellscape, killing enemies with the [b]spellbinding music[/b] of Acryll Madness amplifying every heartbeat. The dynamic compositions will intensify the chaos, turning every moment into an electrifying [b]crescendo of emotions[/b].

Get ready for an unforgettable adventure where the fusion of gaming and music will redefine the way you play. Follow our Steam page for sneak peeks and updates!

Embrace the adrenaline and stay tuned for the release of "Injection" - [b]a symphony of excitement awaits![/b]

[i]Yours in anticipation,
The ButterCorp Team[/i]

notes.title: HAPPY NEW YEAR!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Greetings everyone![/b][/h1]

[h3]Friends, [b]2022 is over[/b]! It was a difficult, but admittedly quite eventful year.
We would like to wish all of you health, strong nerves, as well as more happy and warm moments!

Now we want to inform you that our game participates in the [b]Steam Next Fest[/b], which begins [b]February 6[/b]!

All our efforts are now focused on developing the demo for this fest, so we hope you'll enjoy it! 
Add the game to your[b] Steam Wishlist[/b] so you won't miss any news about it![/h3]

[h2][b]Happy Holidays!🥳🍾[/b][/h2]
